          "quote": "A VideoCardz source confirmed that one board partner already has RTX 50 Super GPUs on hand, but Nvidia has allegedly told the company that the products are on hold because of the price of 3GB GDDR7 memory chips. ... these chips cost twice or thrice as much as their 2GB variants",
          "meaning": "据VideoCardz消息源，至少一家板卡合作商已有RTX 50 Super GPU在手，但据称NVIDIA因3GB GDDR7价格暂停产品；文章称该芯片价格为2GB版本的两至三倍。文章还称NVIDIA自2025年末不再向板卡商随GPU核心供应显存，合作商须自行采购。",
          "weight": "core",
          "pages": ["v19"],
          "why": "直接影响Super系列的上市时间、零售价及板卡商生产意愿；但这是二手消息，不能视为NVIDIA正式延期公告，也没有确认新的
